name: anyone-can-code
description: Docs-native Codex Windows build workflow from any starting point to a verified result.

interface.shortDescription: One front door for idea, repo, bug, polish, and ship workflows.
interface.longDescription: Anyone Can Code is a Windows-first Codex plugin that routes vague ideas, existing repos, features, bugs, reviews, and ship requests into the right workflow. It now uses a bundled MCP memory server for reinforced learning, keeps local project state thin, uses bundled hooks when enabled, supports optional project bootstrap, tracks resumable state, enforces evidence-first verification, and keeps visible communication configurable with normal or caveman modes.
defaultPrompt: I want to build something, but I may be starting from an idea, a repo, or a bug.
Resume my last workflow and tell me the next best step.
Verify what changed and tell me what is still uncertain.
